Irma Santos: Hi team — Irma here, joining Eng Runtime (remote, GMT+1). First-day q: who handles VPN/SSH and MDM? Also which dotfiles do folks recommend? And tiny personal note: I bake scones on Saturdays.

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Irma!! :tada: Buddy = Evan. Swag and shipping: https://redwood.company/swag-form. Any dietary restrictions?

DevEx-Bot: Onboarding checklist created: ONB-6002 for Irma Santos. Items: MDM enrollment, SSH key, Slack groups, repo access.

Jo Park: For SSH: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "irma@redwood.com"` then paste `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` into IT portal. Dotfiles: start with `redwood/dotfiles` and use `--minimal` if you want fewer opinionated tweaks.

IT-Bot: IT ticket #IT-11022 opened: "Onboard Irma Santos - VPN/SSH/MDM" — ETA 1 business day.

Evan (Eng): hey Irma, welcome! I'll DM you to schedule a 15-min repo access walkthrough. If you like scones, we have a bakery map in #random  share favorites when you join.

Lia (Growth): If you're ever in SF, coffee club Wed 3pm — we'd love your baking contributions :smile:.

Irma Santos: Thanks all! No allergies. I'll open the IT ticket now and DM Evan. Excited to join and I'll post scone pics later :croissant:
